# Support

cc-lb is an open-source project. It does not provide a guaranteed response time, support contract, or service-level agreement.

- **How-to and operations:** start with the [documentation site](https://cc-lb.bhyoo.com/docs/) and the repository's [runtime management guide](../docs/runtime-management.md).
- **Reproducible bugs:** open an issue with the [bug report form](https://github.com/isac322/cc-lb/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) and include the cc-lb version or commit, deployment mode, environment, and safe reproduction steps.
- **Install and first-run results:** use the [tried it form](https://github.com/isac322/cc-lb/issues/new?template=tried_it.yml) to report how an install went, including when it worked.
- **Feature requests:** use the [feature request form](https://github.com/isac322/cc-lb/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) and describe the operator problem and desired behavior.
- **Plugin authoring:** use the [plugin author guide](../docs/plugin-author-guide.md).
- **Security vulnerabilities:** follow [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md); do not post sensitive details publicly.
